condition.narrative: Section 1.B.2 of the Schedule to the Operation Agreement - The Implementing Entity shall maintain the Jai Bangla Technical SupportUnit housed in the Finance Department throughout the implementation of the Operation with composition, including technical staff,resources, and terms of reference, acceptable to the Bank, to be responsible for the implementation of the Project.

Section 1.E.1 of the Schedule to the Operation Agreement - Not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date (or such otherdate which the Bank has confirmed in writing to the Implementing Entity is reasonable and acceptable under the circumstances, asdetermined by the Bank in its sole discretion), the Implementing Entity shall prepare and adopt an implementation manual for theOperation (the “Operation Manual”) in form and substance acceptable to the Bank.

Section I.B.1 of Schedule 1 to the Operation Agreement: Without limitation on the generality of Part A of this Section I: (a) theFinance Department shall coordinate the implementation of the Program in connection with the Women and Child Development and SocialWelfare Department, the Health and Family Welfare Department, and the West Bengal Electronics Industry Development CorporationLimited; and (b) the State Jai Bangla Coordination Unit, in close coordination with the agencies under (a) above shall beresponsible for monitoring, evaluation and oversight of the Program and shall be staffed with monitoring and evaluationprofessionals with qualifications, experience and terms of reference acceptable to the Bank, and sufficient budget and resourcesfor said activities.
Section I.C.1. of Schedule 1 to the Operation Agreement: The Implementing Entity shall: implement the Program Action Plan agreedwith the Bank, in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Bank.

Section I.D.1 of Schedule 1 to the Operation Agreement: The Implementing Entity shall ensure that the Project is carried out inaccordance with the Environmental and Social Standards, in a manner acceptable to the Bank.

title.narrative: PDO Indicator 1: Number of beneficiaries of targeted cash transfers from vulnerable groups (disaggregated by gender, with widow pensions as a separate category)

baseline.value: Government has issued orders to roll-out unified Social Protection Delivery Platform under Jai Bangla scheme umbrella

target.value: Cash transfers to 50% beneficiaries under all social protection schemes for vulnerable groups made through Unified Social Protection Delivery System

comment.narrative: The PDO indicator has been achieved.

actual.value:
The PMU has conducted an analysis of all the schemes included under the Jai Bangla platform. As per the analysis, there has been an increase in total number of beneficiaries from 45,81,592 in FY21-22 to 84,45,090 in FY25-26, an increase of approximately 54%. Out of total beneficiaries in FY25-26, 75,57,556 beneficiaries have received benefits equating to 89%. Total number of Widow pensioners are 1,377,000.
The Government will share the data disaggregated by gender for all the schemes.

title.narrative: PDO Indicator 2: Number of beneficiaries of tele-enabled social care services for the elderly/disabled (disaggregated by gender)

baseline.value: Government notification on State policy on Social Care Services

target.value: Social Care Services in all districts of West Bengal

comment.narrative: PDO Indicator has been achieved. However, there is a need to create additional 10,000 spokes to cater to the demand.

actual.value: The Government has developed and operationalized its own telemedicine platform, Swasthyaingit. The telemedicine ecosystem is structured on a hub-and-spoke model, wherein district-level telemedicine centers function as spokes, while state-owned hospitals with super-specialty services serve as hubs. The platform has achieved significant scale, with approximately 10,000 spoke centers operational across all districts and a network of around 8,000 doctors enrolled to provide tele-consultations. Currently, the system facilitates over 80,000 consultations per month. The platform has cumulatively delivered approximately 70.8 million consultations across the state. Notably, utilization patterns indicate strong uptake among women, who account for 64 percent of total beneficiaries, compared to 36 percent male beneficiaries, highlighting the platform's role in improving access to healthcare services, particularly for women.

title.narrative: PDO Indicator 2: Number of beneficiaries of tele-enabled social care services for the elderly/disabled (disaggregated by gender)

baseline.value: Government notification on State policy on Social Care Services

target.value: Social Care Services in all districts of West Bengal

comment.narrative:
There are approximately 10,000 spokes across the state with 8,000 doctors enrolled for consultation and in total over 80,000 consultations are taking place in a month. Total of 22,00,000 lakh consultations have already taken place from across the state.
There is a need to create additional 10,000 spokes to cater to the demand.

actual.value: The government has developed its own tele-medicine platform named "Sawasthyaingit". The tele-medicine ecosystem is based on Hub and Spoke model. The tele-medicine centres in districts spokes and all state owned hospitals with super specialty are Hubs.

title.narrative: PDO Indicator 3: Number of women beneficiaries reached (offered services/interventions/information/support) by job support platforms/pilots through the Program

comment.narrative: The State Government has created six sub-committees to identify interventions in six thematic areas to promote female labor force participation. Of the six sub-committees, two sub-committees have been convened. The committees have identified actions to strengthen LAMPS, SANGHAs, City Level Federations, and City Livelihood Centers to provide skilling and job-related services to women. The transport sub-committee has identified actions for both (i) improving transport services for women, and (ii) create ecosystem for women to participate as service providers in the transport sector. The pilot will be initiated post conclusion of the state assembly elections.
